# sreagent_ai_settings (Resource)

Organization-wide AI settings. One row per organization: creating it adopts the current settings, destroying it leaves them in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_ai_settings" "this" {
  anonymization_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `anonymization_enabled` (Boolean) Anonymize data sent to models.
- `multi_agent_investigation` (Boolean) Use multi-agent investigations.
- `own_providers_only` (Boolean) Route only to the organization's own providers.
- `retry_budget` (Number) Retries on transient provider errors; answers the budget in force.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `retry_budget_configured` (Boolean) Whether retry_budget was set rather than defaulted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# A singleton imports by its own name.
terraform import sreagent_ai_settings.this ai_settings
```
